SELECT e.exercise_id, e.name, e.body_part, e.met_value, e.default_sets, e.default_reps, e.default_sec, e.instruction, e.media_type, e.media_url, r.phase, r.sort_order, e.default_sets AS sets, e.default_reps AS reps, e.default_sec AS duration_sec FROM home_workout_rules r JOIN home_exercises e ON e.exercise_id = r.exercise_id WHERE e.is_active = 1 AND r.intensity = #{intensity} AND r.age_group IN (#{ageGroup}, #{ageBand}, '전체', 'ALL')
AND r.bmi_grade IN (#{bmiGrade}, '전체', 'ALL')
AND r.gender IN (#{gender}, 'ALL') ORDER BY CASE r.phase WHEN 'WARMUP' THEN 1 WHEN 'MAIN' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, CASE WHEN r.age_group = #{ageGroup} THEN 0 WHEN r.age_group = #{ageBand} THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, CASE WHEN r.bmi_grade = #{bmiGrade} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CASE WHEN r.gender = #{gender} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, r.sort_order, e.exercise_id
